scripts.test: node -e "import('./tests/core-tests.js').then(m => { const r = m.runCoreTests(); console.log(`Tests: ${r.passed} passed, ${r.failed} failed`); if (r.failed) process.exit(1); })"
scripts.validate: node -e "import('./js/data.js').then(m => { const fs = require('fs'); const res = m.validateData(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/songs.json'))); if (res.errors.length) { console.error(res.errors); process.exit(1); } console.log(`Validation OK: ${res.songs.length} songs`); })"
